label: Media Briefing & Q&A Prep
description: Prepare for media interviews and briefings: key messages, anticipated questions with model answers, bridging techniques, and dos and don'ts for spokespeople.

guidedInputs.label: Topic / Subject Matter
guidedInputs.description: What is the media interaction about?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Interview with Financial Times about our response to the new EU AML regulation and its impact on Nordic fintech sector...

guidedInputs.label: Spokesperson Details
guidedInputs.description: Who will be speaking and what is their role?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. CEO, experienced media performer but tends to go off-message, strong on vision but weak on technical details...

guidedInputs.label: Anticipated Difficult Questions
guidedInputs.description: What tough questions might be asked?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Why were compliance gaps not detected earlier? How do you respond to competitors' claims? What about the recent enforcement action?
